name: Event-Driven Architect Pack
description: Workflows for coding agents designing event-driven and distributed systems: messaging and event-flow patterns, resilient interface contracts, schema evolution, observability across services, and debugging eventual-consistency failures.
useCases: Design event-driven systems with well-chosen messaging patterns and resilient contracts between services.
Plan schema evolution for events without breaking existing consumers.
Debug eventual-consistency failures using observability across service boundaries.
examplePrompts: Design the event flow for this order-processing system, including delivery guarantees, retries, and dead-letter handling.
Two services disagree about this entity's state — trace the event flow and find where consistency breaks.
